answer: What survives to the dawn is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The terrace is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the comet. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
